name: From Earth
source:
You play as a human who got transported into an unknown reality. There you will first meet a wolf who will get very attached to you for some reason. You will also meet other people who will help you fit in in this new world you have been thrown in to...

[From [url=https://fromearthvn.itch.io/from-earth]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你扮演一个被传送到未知现实的人类。在那里你会首先遇到一只狼，它会因为某种原因非常依恋你。你还将遇到其他人，他们将帮助你融入这个你所投入的新世界……

[来自[url=https://fromearthvn.itch.io/from-earth]Itch.io[/url]]
